text:
Oli (Sales): Quick handoff for Asterion Health - contract signed, $15k/mo ARR, 12mo starting 2026-04-01. Primary use: clinical note summarization + private (VPC) deployment. Outstanding: Okta SSO + SCIM, PII/PHI redaction rules, request for on-prem eval. IT lead is julia@asterion.com. Looping CS/Support/Eng.

Megan (CS): Thanks - I'll take overall onboarding. High level milestones: 1) SSO + SCIM setup (Raj) 2) Private deploy checklist & infra request (Kelsey) 3) Eval env + success criteria + 30d check-ins (me). Flagging renewal risk: if eval shows poor quality or cost spikes, renewal health will drop. Need clear eval success metrics.

Raj (Support): Can you share SAML metadata (IdP cert) and whether they want SP-initiated or IdP-initiated? Also need data residency constraints for private deploy (region). I created initial ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5231 - assigned to support queue.

Oli (Sales): Sending metadata + anonymized sample dataset now. Also attaching customer note about their redaction needs: they want all PHI tags removed and a custom rule for lab values flagged as "sensitive". Will intro Julia in email thread.

Kelsey (SRE): I can prep a private dev cluster (dedicated pool) and a prototype redaction hook. Estimate: 10 business days to deliver POC. Need: (a) anonymized sample payloads, (b) IAM account for dev (temporary), (c) approval for isolated infra spend. Suggest quantization profile q4-16 to lower token cost for long notes.

Megan (CS): Action summary (please ack):
- SSO/SCIM docs + metadata -> owner: Raj -> due: 2026-03-05
- Dev private cluster & redaction POC -> owner: Kelsey -> due: 2026-03-12
- Eval env & success criteria doc -> owner: Megan -> due: 2026-03-08
- Weekly check-ins first 30 days -> owner: Megan -> cadence: weekly starting first day of deploy
- Capture prompt/regression feedback -> owner: Megan/Kelsey -> store in CS repo (link below)
Please add any missing items.

Raj (Support): Acked. Need the Okta metadata and example SAML response. Quick note: our SSO onboarding template expects this snippet - ask IT to provide: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.asterion.com">...```

Oli (Sales): Copy of SAML metadata uploaded to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/asterion/sso-metadata.xml. Sample dataset (anonymized) at https://s3.redwood.com/asterion/samples/clinical-notes.json.gz. Intro email to Julia done; she replied she can do an Okta SP test next Tuesday.

Kelsey (SRE): I'll open infra request INF-9987 for the dev cluster. Also will include a small test harness for redaction rules and a smoke test that runs: ```curl -X POST https://dev-infer.redwood/private/run -d @sample.json``` to validate pipeline.

Oncall Bot: Automated note: deployment window for private dev cluster reserved 2026-03-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pagerduty will be alerted for any failures.

Raj (Support): Updated ticket CS-5231 with Okta metadata link and sample dataset. Marked priority: P2.

Megan (CS): Two non-technical asks from customer: 1) a 30-minute enablement session for 6 clinical users after deploy, 2) weekly feedback form for prompt quality (I'll draft). I'll put a Google form link in the CS repo.

Oli (Sales): Noting they care about cost. If dev POC shows high token spend, they may ask for custom batching/caching config. Kelsey, please include recommendations in POC.

Kelsey (SRE): Will include batching config suggestions and expected token cost delta. Also can try prefix caching on long notes.

Megan (CS): I'll create JIRA epic CS-ASTERION-1 and link all tickets. Epic will track onboarding, infra, enablement, and renewal health checks. Initial risk label: "monitor".

Raj (Support): Anything else you need from me before I start SSO work?

Megan (CS): Please schedule a 30-min sync with Julia and Raj next Tue after her Okta test. I'll create calendar invite.

Oli (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup:. I'll follow up on the email intro and post any IT responses here.

Kelsey (SRE): :thumbsup: will start infra request today.

Megan (CS): I'll post the weekly feedback form and the onboarding checklist in the CS Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/Asterion.

(End of thread)
